g.text: Strap tensioner: one turn of the crank, a sixth of the spool
17 on 34 below (faint), then 17 on 51 above (module 1.5, herringbone): the crank (blue) once, the middle shaft half a turn back, the spool a sixth
The ratchet (yellow) turns under the pawl (red), which drops into each tooth: it holds the spool when you let go
